utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on Rosa to confirm the time, and I’d rather not send people the wrong details. Once that’s set, I can help keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia — I’ll wait for Rosa’s confirmation before we share anything. Once she sends the time, I’m happy to help keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot — I’m just trying to avoid mix-ups until Rosa confirms the time.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — I’ll watch for it and keep everyone posted once the time’s set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, thanks — checking the damaged wiring first makes sense. Let me know if the order shifts once you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.text: Mina: Great—what supplies do you want me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mina — please bring a few basic tools, gloves, and some rags. I’ll make sure everyone knows where to help on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring tools, gloves, and rags on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still here for it, just a little behind on the details. What’s still missing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still helping recruit neighbors for Sunday’s repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’m still on recruit duty for Sunday’s repair drive — I’ll follow up with a few neighbors today.

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it — I’ll pass that along in order and keep an ear out for any timing updates too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good — if anything changes, I’ll keep the list in order and let you know first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — I’ve got it covered, and I’ll keep an eye out for your time and contact details next.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — I’ll send the time and contact details next. The repair drive is at the community center on Maple, just past the library; take Oak over and turn right at the park.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — send the time and contact details when you can, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — I’m still in for the repair drive. I’ll send the time and place shortly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Leo — I’ll keep an eye out for the time and place. Just let me know if there’s anything else I should handle.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do, Sam — I’ll send the time and place as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll send the time and place again. Thanks for being in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — Sunday at the community center works, and I can help with the easiest route if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect — Sunday at the community center sounds right. I’ll send it out again and keep the easy route in mind, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an eye out while I’m running errands and pass along any supply updates if I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. I’ll keep track of what we still need and let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll let you know if I hear anything new while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m checking with Ira now and will send you the time plus the first fix list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll wait for your update, then share the time and first fix list with the group.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll confirm the slot with Ira and send the time plus the first fix list as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the first repair.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Gus — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I hear the first repair.

utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mara — I’m still waiting on Rosa’s final time, but I’ll send it as soon as I have it so everyone can plan around the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — once Rosa’s final time comes in, I’ll help get it out to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mara — I really appreciate it. I’ll pass along Rosa’s final time as soon as it lands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Quinn. I really appreciate you taking care of it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course, Uli — I’ve got it covered and I’ll keep you posted as soon as I have the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Quinn. I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re still good to help this week, right? Just send me the repair list by priority.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple and send the repair list in priority order today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just confirming — you’ll send it today, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still only catching bits and pieces — what’s the latest on the repair drive, and what are they fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking the location and route details; I haven’t heard the first repair item yet, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — that works for me. I’ll keep listening for the first repair item and send it along if I hear anything.

utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the time and place, and I’ll help however you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — what should I do first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Start by sending me the time and place, and I’ll take it from there for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I’m still in for the repair drive—what are we fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, glad you’re in. What should I bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take care of the remaining list and start with whatever’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — please start with the most urgent homes and let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Vik — just keep me posted, and I’ll work around the school schedule for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep everyone posted and share the final repair drive time as soon as it’s set around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Vik — once you have the final time, I’ll make sure it fits around the school schedule.

utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I’m ready to sort the donations once you send the list. I’ll keep an eye out for what still needs covering.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll send the current supply list over shortly so you can sort the donations. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll be ready when it comes through, and I’ll start sorting right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — I’ll let everyone know as soon as you send the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send it over shortly — thanks, Ira.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’m on it, and I’ll pass along the details as soon as you send them.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
